Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Eligibility Criteria: Only Manufacturers or their authorized dealers/ distributors (except for Q1 & Q2 categ

ory) need to quote with valid authorization from the manufacturers failing which offer will be summarily rej ected. In case bidders participate as an authorized agent, then the performance as required above shall be that o f the Principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentials of past supply for a d ifferent Principal but this will not be considered as performance for placing bulk order in case of change of Principal. The Bidder should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 20% of bid quantity , in at least on e of the last three financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PS U / Public Listed Company. Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in an y one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant financial year. The similar product category will be the bid item having same description, but of different sizes/ratin gs/capacities. The bidder is required to submit proof of successful supply. Purchase order alone shall not b e c onsidered as work experience. In case of any documents submitted by bidders are found to be forged o r fake, the concerned bidder shall be debarred for future purchases and the action of suspension from the GeM shall also be initiated. The onus of submission of requisite documents such as copies CRAC, CRN, Receipt note shall be responsibi lity of the bidder. 2. Payment Terms:-100% Payment after supply, inspection and acceptance by Consignee. 3. Warranty Clause:- As per IRS Conditions (30 Months). 4. Sample Clause: Two number of sample to be supplied and get approved by the firm from the consignee before bulk supply. One approved sample to be retained with consignee and bulk supply will be matched with this approved sample. 5. In compliance of Make in India Purchase Preference Policy, Make in India Declaration from OEM must be uploaded along with offer, otherwise offer will be summarily rejected. 6. Inspection by consignee at his destination. 7. Material will be delivered at RPF post Haridwar station. . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
